notes.title: 🔥 New update available ! 🔥
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re very excited to bring you this update with features requested by the community, the main focus of this update is to make exploration more enjoyable, it includes :

🗺️ Addition of a map.

📡 Introduction of a radar item that allows you to locate hidden items on the map. This item is acquired after defeating the third boss.

🚀 Additional teleportation portals to speed up travel between areas and enhance exploration.

🗡️ Increase in the main character's melee attack range.

👹 Addition of an anticipation animation for the third boss's melee attack.

🛠️ Various minor bug fixes for a smoother experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028325/389034dceed9031b0193e3dc11ca516191c9408f.png[/img]
We hope you will be happy with these changes ! Update your game now and let us know what you think in the discussions! We can't wait to read your feedback !

notes.title: We Hear You!
notes.content:
Dear players,

First of all, we would like to say a big THANK YOU to everyone who played Souno's Curse, especially to those of you who took the time to share their feedback ! We’ve been closely listening to what you’ve been saying, and we want you to know that we are fully committed to improving your experience in Souno's Curse.

Based on your feedback, we are currently working on an update addressing the issues raised, our highest priority being to [b]add a map to the game[/b]. We’re doing everything to publish the update as quickly as possible. 

We truly appreciate your input so please keep the feedback coming, and thank you for being part of our amazing community.

Stay tuned for the next update !

Cheers,
Kiro Team

notes.title: Souno’s Curse is officially released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The day has finally come—Souno’s Curse is officially released! This project has been a true journey, filled with challenges, stress, late nights, and moments of creative euphoria. Seeing the game evolve from the initial idea to the final result has been an incredible experience.

We can’t wait for you to explore the game’s universe and story, and we’re eagerly looking forward to your feedback. Every message, every comment, and every idea is valuable to the team.

We hope you enjoy Souno’s Curse as much as we enjoyed creating it, and we’ll see you in a few months for the console release!

See you soon,
The Kiro Team.

notes.title: Speedrun Contest starts with amazing rewards !
notes.content:
Hello people,

To make our Kickstarter campaign more fun and interesting ! We want to start a fun speedrun contest for the demo of the game. The concept is simple: Start the demo and finish it as fast as you can. The contest is open to everyone, veterans and beginners.

[h3]Rules[/h3]
- Record your gameplay session with a timer on the screen. You can use LiveSplit as a timer since it's one of the most popular with speedrunners

- The countdown starts the moment you press the "Start the Demo" button and ends the moment the Owl Knight dialogue [b]STARTS[/b]

- Post your run on Twitter using the tags @KiroTeamGames and #kickstarterSpeedrun

- The contest ends on November 10th, 23h59 GMT 

[h3]Rewards[/h3]

[b]1st[/b] 
We have a special NPC in the game, the world's fastest creature ! A fun and engaging character with many surprises, appearing in different places throughout the game. 
As the winner, you can give him/her your name and be remembered as the best ! (You can name him/her differently if you prefer)

[b]2nd[/b] and [b]3rd[/b] 
Get your name on statues of athletes in the character's village


So show us what you got, this little guy is eager to have a name
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41028325/6f629f454d0a935c6712f840ec50d825eee5c595.png[/img]

 
Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or remarks
Good luck !
Idir
